description: Get a booking link for a hotel on Gondola. Use this when a user wants to book a specific hotel. Returns a URL to the hotel's booking page with dates pre-filled. Pass gondola_rate_id when a specific rate is known so the link deep-links straight to that rate's checkout page.

gondola_rate_id.description: Optional rate ID from get_hotel_rates or compare_rates. When provided, the link deep-links straight to that rate's checkout page instead of the generic hotel page.

name: get_booking_link
